decisive_items: diffuse, generalized hyperintensity of the supratentorial white matter on T2/FLAIR sequences
response.rationale: The combination of progressive gait disturbance, rigid-akinetic syndrome, and specific MRI findings supports Progressive Supranuclear Palsy over other candidates.

rejected.why: Lack of distinct parkinsonian features and gait disturbance
Normal CSF cell count and lack of contrast enhancement on MRI are not typical for Normal Pressure Hydrocephalus
